title: Decision response (contract C3, spec 0.1)
description: The answer to POST /v1/runtime/check. It is runtime/gateway/internal/models.DecisionResponse.

decision_id.description: Names this decision; an approval can be created for it, and a receipt cites it.

reason_codes.description: Why, as stable codes (spec/decision-api.md lists them). A client acts on the decision, never on a reason.

approval_id.description: Set when the gateway opened an approval while deciding.

receipt_stub.description: Facts the caller's own receipt should carry, among them policy_hash (the policy decided under) and action_digest (the digest of the evaluated request that an approval binds).

matched_rule.description: The rule that decided, by its description or a generated name, when one did.
